lines.text: Paul and his companions were torn away from the Thessalonians for a short time, and Satan obstructed their return.
When they could bear it no longer, they were willing to be left alone in Corinth and sent Timothy.
Paul sent to learn about their faith, afraid the tempter had tempted them and their labor might be in vain.
Timothy returned with good news about the Thessalonians' faith and love, and said they longed to see Paul.
Night and day they prayed to see the Thessalonians face to face and supply what was lacking in their love.
